integrity: Exact all-order proof plus a separate reproducing code sample. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only even simple cycles with strictly positive prices alternating between two edge classes; objective is the continuous-time Laplacian spectral gap, not discrete-time SLEM. The exact proof establishes all parameter cases; finite computational samples alone do not. Equivalence to an unindexed published specialization remains possible.
title: Exact and unique fastest diffusion on two-price even cycles
